name: What can go wrong if grout is sealed the wrong way?
description: Wrong timing or poor cleanup can trap moisture, weaken protection, or leave sealer haze on the tile surface.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if grout is sealed the wrong way?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are **sealing dirty grout, trapping moisture, or leaving haze on the tile**. If grout is not fully dry, the sealer may not bond well; if excess sealer dries on tile faces, it can leave a dull film that is harder to remove later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wrong timing or poor cleanup can trap moisture, weaken protection, or leave sealer haze on the tile surface.
